newsitem.title: USA: PECO Peach Bottom Pa. nuke trips off line.
newsitem.headline: PECO Peach Bottom Pa. nuke trips off line.

text.p: PECO Energy Co's Peach Bottom 3 nuclear unit was taken off line Sunday after a recirculation pump tripped, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission said Monday in its daily plant status report.
Peach Bottom 3 was in a hot shutdown mode as of early Monday, the NRC said, typically indicating the 1,100 megawatt unit could resume production relatively quickly.
The NRC said in its status report that Peach Bottom 3 was tentatively scheduled to restart on March 10.
A company spokesman could not immediately comment on the outage or on a possible restart date for the unit, located in Delta, Pa.
The unit's recirculation pump tripped after the main turbine had been tripped for a preplanned drywell entry, the NRC said.
The adjoining Peach Bottom nuclear power unit 2, also with a capacity of 1,100 megawatts, was operating normally at full capacity as of early Monday, the NRC said.
